categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main segments: environmental water treatment systems and hydrogen fuel cell engine systems. The water treatment segment focuses on equipment for nuclear power plants, thermal power plants, metallurgy, chemical industries, and municipal sectors, including condensate water precision treatment, desalinated water treatment (including seawater desalination), sewage treatment, and water intake engineering systems. The hydrogen fuel cell segment involves R&D, design, and integration of hydrogen fuel cell engine systems for vehicles and special equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as high-tower resin separation for condensate water precision treatment, thermal-membrane coupled seawater desalination technology combining low-temperature multi-effect distillation and reverse osmosis, and integrated sewage treatment technologies. In hydrogen fuel cells, it has developed proprietary technologies including low-platinum membrane electrode assemblies, high-performance metal bipolar plates with advanced coating, automated fuel cell stack assembly, and system integration with redundancy and fault-tolerant controls. Production methods include modular design, automated assembly lines for fuel cell stacks, and customized manufacturing through collaboration with suppliers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major state-owned power generation groups such as China National Nuclear Corporation, China General Nuclear Power Group, Huaneng Group, Datang Group, Huadian Group, State Energy Group, and State Power Investment Corporation, as well as large local power generation enterprises. The company serves nuclear and thermal power plants, industrial enterprises in metallurgy, chemical, and petrochemical sectors, municipal water treatment projects, and vehicle manufacturers for hydrogen fuel cell engines. Overseas markets include South America, Southeast Asia, South Asia, the Middle East, and Europe, with projects under the Belt and Road initiative.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with business concentrated in North China, East China, Northwest China, Southwest China, South China, Northeast China, and Central China regions. It also has international projects in countries such as Venezuela, Vietnam, Indonesia, Brunei, and Pakistan. The company actively participates in the Belt and Road strategy to expand its overseas presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It focuses on R&D, design, system integration, and assembly of water treatment systems and hydrogen fuel cell engine systems. It procures core components and raw materials from suppliers but performs system integration and final assembly internally, especially for hydrogen fuel cell stacks and engines. It does not directly manufacture all components but collaborates with specialized suppliers for customized parts.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes strengthening its leading position in nuclear and thermal power water treatment markets, expanding hydrogen fuel cell engine system business as a second growth curve, and broadening into non-power industrial water treatment and municipal sectors. R&D priorities include advancing high-tower resin separation technology, thermal-membrane coupled seawater desalination, membrane electrode and bipolar plate technologies, fuel cell stack automation, system integration, and hydrogen storage and power generation. The company invests heavily in innovation, holding numerous patents and software copyrights, and collaborates with research institutes and universities to accelerate technology commercialization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through sales of water treatment system equipment and hydrogen fuel cell engine systems, including design, procurement, and construction contracts (EP and EPC models), as well as build-own-operate-transfer (BOOT) projects where the company invests in, operates, and maintains water treatment facilities and earns income from selling treated water. The hydrogen fuel cell business mainly sells engine systems to vehicle manufacturers through tendering and commercial negotiations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the domestic market for condensate water precision treatment systems for nuclear and large thermal power plants, being one of the few suppliers meeting stringent nuclear power plant requirements. It is recognized as a national specialized and innovative 'little giant' enterprise and a provincial 'hidden champion.' In seawater desalination and hydrogen fuel cell engine systems, it is among the domestic leaders with advanced proprietary technologies. Competitors include other domestic and international water treatment and fuel cell system providers, but the company’s integrated technology and comprehensive service capabilities provide competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 255 million, a 25.53% increase over the previous year, but reported a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 87.8 million, a significant decline compared to prior periods. The company’s total assets reached approximately RMB 1 billion, with net assets attributable to shareholders around RMB 492 million. The company increased R&D investment by 48.39% to over RMB 27 million, reflecting a focus on innovation despite profitability challenges. Cash flow from operating activities turned positive at RMB 7.8 million, improving from a negative position in the prior year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through proprietary core technologies with independent intellectual property rights, especially in high-precision condensate water treatment for nuclear power plants and integrated hydrogen fuel cell engine systems. Its products meet stringent quality and stability requirements critical for power generation and automotive applications. The company offers highly integrated, modular, and automated system solutions with strong after-sales and technical support, enabling reliable, efficient, and environmentally friendly operations. Its commitment to innovation and alignment with national green and low-carbon policies further enhance its competitive positioning.
